<thought>Mass spectrometry shows a molecular ion at m/z ≈ 100.0524, which matches the exact mass of the formula C₅H₈O₂. This formula has a double‑bond equivalent of 2, consistent with an unsaturated carboxylic acid. A common structure fitting C₅H₈O₂ is pent‑2‑enoic acid, whose SMILES is **CC=CCC(=O)O**. This SMILES is valid and corresponds to the required molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>CC=CCC(=O)O</final_answer>
